# Inna Ivanova — Product Designer

> Senior product designer based in Lisbon, Portugal, open to remote roles.
> 6 years in product teams: B2B tools for dark store operations at Samokat,
> EdTech at Moscow Electronic School, and Lunel — an iOS app she designed
> and built with Claude Code.

## About

- Looking for: Product Designer or Senior Product Designer roles, remote or in Lisbon.
- Domains: B2B (E-commerce, quick commerce, warehouse operations, EdTech), B2C (FemTech, HealthTech).
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Web.
- Owns the full cycle: runs her own UX research, defines success metrics before designing, tests hypotheses, reviews implementation, surveys users after launch.
- AI-assisted product design: sets up Claude Code with rules, acceptance criteria and custom skills. Lunel's code was written by Claude Code under her review.
- Languages: English, Russian.
- Also known as: innarenard, Инна Иванова.

## Case studies

- [Lunel](https://innarenard.com/lunel/) (2026, iOS, FemTech): cycle tracking app taken from idea to an MVP on the App Store — research, design system, 8 languages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lunel-private-cycle-tracker/id6761544338
- [Order picking](https://innarenard.com/order-picking/) (Samokat, 2025, iOS/Android): Time to Task −2.3%, two fewer error types, UX 4.7/5.
- [Transfers of goods](https://innarenard.com/transfers-of-goods/) (Samokat, 2024, iOS/Android): savings of 4M RUB, −5% overdue shipments, UX 4.8/5.
- [Picking priority](https://innarenard.com/picking-priority/) (Samokat, 2025, Web): Time to Task −4.4%, UX 4.8/5.
- [Picker schedule](https://innarenard.com/picker-schedule/) (Samokat, 2025, iOS/Android): −4% order→delivery, −6% order→assembly start, +2% peak-hour orders.
- [Teacher's journal](https://innarenard.com/teachers-journal/) (Moscow Electronic School, 2023, iOS/Android): designed from scratch, UX 8.1/10.
- [Colleges](https://innarenard.com/colleges/) (Moscow Electronic School, 2023, Web): redesign, UX 8.9/10.
